name: Karelia Tobacco Company Inc.
summary: Karelia Tobacco Company Inc. engages in the production, wholesale, and distribution of tobacco products in Greece, European Union, Africa, Asia, and other European countries. The company provides cigarettes, roll-your-own tobacco, and cigars under the George Karelias and Sons, Omé, Karelia Slims, Karelia Blue, Oriental Mist, American Legend, Leader, Karelia Royal, and Wellington brand names. Karelia Tobacco Company Inc. was founded in 1888 and is based in Kalamata, Greece.
